text: Provides a REST API for authenticating, making requests, and retrieving fraud data
quote: This document will show you how to use Signifyd's REST API to authenticate, make requests, and retrieve data.

text: Sale endpoint records a completed purchase and payment authorization in a post-auth workflow
quote: The Sale endpoint in Signifyd's API is used to record a Sale Event, which represents the completion of a purchase flow and the associated payment authorization in a **PostAuth** workflow.

text: Checkout endpoint records a pre-auth checkout event before the payment gateway is called, enabling real-time risk scoring before authorization
quote: The Checkout endpoint in Signifyd's API is used to record a Checkout Event in a Pre-Auth flow. This call should be made _before_ calling your Payment Gateway.

text: API endpoint to retrieve the latest fraud decision for an order
quote: Retrieve the latest fraud decision for an order in the Signifyd system.

text: Can record a chargeback event against an order to initiate chargeback handling
quote: To create a chargeback against an Order in the Signifyd system, you need to record a Chargeback Event.

text: Can record the outcome of a chargeback representment via API
quote: To set the outcome of a Chargeback's Representment in the Signifyd system, you need to record a Representment Outcome Event.

text: Can programmatically create new webhooks via the API
quote: Create a new webhook. This will add to the list of any existing webhooks.

text: Sends real-time webhook notifications when a guarantee decision is made on an order
quote: Signifyd can send a webhook to notify your online store every time a guarantee decision is made on a submitted order. This provides you with real-time updates enabling you to ship orders quickly and efficiently.

text: API layer rejects requests containing unwanted sensitive data
quote: Signifyd has implemented various protocols at the API layer that will reject requests that are identified to contain unwanted sensitive data.

text: Provides an async-loading checkout page script for data collection without affecting page load
quote: Place the following script just before the closing `</head>` tag on your checkout page. The script loads asynchronously and does not affect page load time.

text: Store integration sends orders to Signifyd for Guaranteed Fraud Protection, shifting liability for approved fraudulent orders
quote: Integrating Signifyd on your online stores enables orders placed on your stores to be sent to Signifyd for Guaranteed Fraud Protection.

text: Offers mobile SDKs with instructions and project files to integrate Signifyd into apps
quote: SDKs provide mobile application developers with self-contained libraries for implementing Signifyd. Each SDK include instructions, examples, and project files to allow you to quickly add Signifyd to an existing project.

text: Merchants can cancel the fraud guarantee on an order after a return, refund, or appeasement
quote: Once a return, refund, or appeasement has been completed, merchants can cancel the Signifyd Guarantee associated with the order.

text: Offers chargeback recovery capability to manage and respond to disputes
quote: Chargeback Recovery Take charge of your chargebacks
